item.title: Version 1.2.2
item.description:
• The top of the window now shows whether Pake is activated, Create shows how many free apps are left, and ⇧⌘L opens the license card.
  • When the license server is busy, Pake asks you to try again later and keeps working offline for up to 7 days, instead of ending the license.

• 窗口顶部会显示 Pake 是否已激活，创建按钮下面会写还剩几个免费应用，按 ⇧⌘L 就能打开许可证。
  • 许可证服务器繁忙时会提示稍后再试，这期间最多 7 天照常可用，不会再因此失去激活。

item.title: Version 1.2.1
item.description: • The field on the home page now leads with pasting a web address, so it reads as the place to start an app rather than a search box.
• 首页的输入框改成先说粘贴网址，一看就知道是从这里开始创建应用，不再像一个搜索框。

item.title: Version 1.2.0
item.description: • Pake now runs on Linux too, and one license covers Mac, Windows and Linux on up to 3 devices.
• Pake 现在也有 Linux 版本了，同一个许可证在 Mac、Windows 和 Linux 上通用，最多 3 台设备。

item.title: Version 1.1.2
item.description:
• Buy License now opens a one-page checkout, with your email and payment on the same screen. In Simplified Chinese it charges in yuan and shows WeChat Pay up front.
  • The License card explains itself in plainer words, and its button for every device is now called Deactivate All.

• 点「购买许可证」会打开单页结账，邮箱和付款在同一页填完，简体中文按人民币结算，微信支付放在最前面。
  • 许可证卡片上的说明改得更直白了。

item.title: Version 1.1.1
item.description:
• A new app icon, a mother holding her baby.
  • On a slow or broken network, looking up a site's name and icon now stops within 15 seconds instead of hanging.
  • The window opens just tall enough to show the whole gallery, until you drag it to a height of your own.
  • Text sizes, shadows and arrows now match throughout the app.

• 换了新的应用图标，是一位抱着孩子的妈妈。
  • 网络慢或者断开时，查网站名称和图标最多等 15 秒，不会再一直卡着。
  • 窗口打开时的高度刚好放下整个精选，自己拖过高度之后就按你的来。
  • 界面里的字号、阴影和箭头都统一了，看着更整齐。

item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description:
• Paste any website address and Pake names the app for you, using the site's official app icon when it has one.
  • Nearly a hundred popular sites, such as Slack, Gmail and Feishu, now open with tuned settings and a matching icon.
  • Fixed garbled app names from some Chinese websites.
  • A refreshed app icon, with clearer text and finer borders throughout.

• 粘贴任意网址，Pake 会自动起好应用名称，网站有官方 App 时直接用它的图标。
  • Slack、Gmail、飞书等近百个常用网站，打开就带好调过的设置和对应图标。
  • 修复部分中文网站取到的应用名称是乱码的问题。
  • 更新了应用图标，界面文字层次和描边也更清晰。

item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
• Create desktop apps from website addresses or the built-in gallery, without installing developer tools.
  • Customize windows, styles and scripts, and keep separate apps for different accounts.
  • Export app settings and import them on another computer to recreate your apps.

• 输入网址或从应用库选择网站，即可创建桌面应用，无需安装开发工具。
  • 按需调整窗口、样式和脚本，同一网站可创建多份应用，分别登录不同账号。
  • 导入导出应用设置，便于在另一台电脑上重新创建应用。
